title: Attached documents should be extracted into reply context
body: Extend chat attachments beyond images so PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV documents are extracted locally and included in the prompt context used for replies.
interface: document-reader extracts attached PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and CSV content for chat context. The tests call: `plugins/document-reader/document-extract.js` (new) exports `extractDocument(filePathOrBuffer, options)`, `extractDocx(buffer)`, `extractXlsx(buffer)`, `extractPptx(buffer)`, `extractCsv(input)`, `extractText(input, type)` and `chunkDocument(text, options)`; `plugins/document-reader/pdf-text.js` (new) exports `extractPdfTextWithOcr(buffer, options)`; the plugin is `plugins/document-reader/document-reader.js`.
why: Document attachment support is one of the capability-roadmap items and forces multi-file backend/frontend reasoning.
